answer: What survives to the tide is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, revoked by a single upheld challenge, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Every claim climbs the quill of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the haven re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
